title: Racket Stringing Service Monthly Throughput Trend
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stringing:service
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as items sum(eval(if(service_status="done",1,0))) as completed by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how many stringing jobs entered the system each month and how many actually got completed.
value: Throughput trend lines show whether the queue is shrinking, flat, or quietly becoming a backlog.
implementation: Use this after any process cleanup to see whether the change actually improved completion volume.
visualization: Column chart of monthly created versus completed stringing jobs.
grandmaExplanation: It turns whether you are clearing stringing jobs as fast as they arrive each month.
